changelog: Header icons (notifications, watchlist, downloads, settings) are centred in their circles instead of sitting in the top-left corner
The header subtitle (HOME • NOW STREAMING and the other section labels) uses a smaller font, so the full text stays visible next to the buttons
CineStream TV grid lists each channel once: playlist mirrors such as 'ATN BANGLA [2]' are collapsed, taking the list from 586 entries to 316 unique channels
The player's channel queue follows the same de-duplicated list, so next/previous channel no longer jumps through mirror copies
